fichas.title: Electrical Consumer Appliances
fichas.summary: Legend of electrical symbols for domestic appliances, cooking equipment, refrigeration, heating, ventilation, motors, and electrically heated screens.
uses: Identify electrical consumer appliances on technical and construction drawings

fichas.title: Lighting Symbols
fichas.summary: Drawing legend for general, adjustable, switched, dimmable, emergency, discharge, fluorescent, and light-band fittings. Examples specify lamp counts and wattages.
uses: Represent lighting equipment and lighting arrangements on drawings

fichas.title: Signal and Radio Devices
fichas.summary: Legend of symbols for detection, fire and security alarms, communications, clocks, sound equipment, and related controls. Some symbols specify electrical current or signal frequency.
uses: Represent signal, alarm, radio, telephone, and communications devices on drawings
